name: RC-B10-0419/2025 – After recital A – Am 3
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on a united response to recent Russian violations of the EU Member States’ airspace and critical infrastructure
part_text: Ra. whereas, in a recent interview, former German Chancellor Angela Merkel assigned significant responsibility to Poland and the Baltic States for the current conflict in Ukraine, stating that their opposition in 2021 to direct dialogue between the European Union and Russian President Vladimir Putin, aimed at surpassing the deadlock of the Minsk Agreements, obstructed the adoption of a diplomatic approach intended to prevent escalation, effectively leaving the door open for the subsequent aggression by the Russian Federation;
